name: Remy Rizzo
home: the western blocks near Ferry Street Rooms
life: “I hosted my first paid party under a staircase with three mismatched stools.” People around Lighthouse Cove know Remy by a small Thursday habit. Remy takes a few minutes by the low rocks, where conversation sounds different as the tide turns.
voice: I lent my birthday room for a joint rehearsal. I'm keeping the first wrong note on the invitation.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a red windbreaker and a fabric zip pull cut from a school scarf. Remy has a deep crease beside the mouth when smiling, with short black hair swept back. Remy looks toward the door whenever a name is called during a conversation.
personality: Remy has a talent for getting adversaries to laugh at exactly the same thing. Remy knows better than to expect the laugh to settle what they are arguing about.
agenda: To give the players a room for an ordinary, imperfect rehearsal.
family: Nico Wells is Remy’s cousin. Remy offers the first invitation. Nico gets to change the plan. They learned that a promise to visit is easier to keep when changing a time does not count as letting down the whole family. Asked about *First shift back*, Nico says, “I know what it costs to return without being cured of ordinary sadness.”
connections: Hannah Peters. A noise complaint and a rehearsal invite turn one ceiling recording into something worth keeping.

reactions.response: Remy contacts the owner before treating an audition as permission to keep the horn.

reactions.situation: A coworker arrives late after a night at the hospital
reactions.response: Remy writes down the shift time accurately, then helps them explain the circumstances without having to tell the whole room.

reactions.response: Remy asks them to describe one concrete thing that will be different tomorrow.
